description: Search spoken Westminster Hansard contributions by topic, member, House, date or numeric debateSectionId. Returns full source contribution text where supplied, including HTML; previews are labelled summaries. Repeat with a returned debateSectionId to search that section, which does not establish an entire debate transcript. Historical completeness is not guaranteed, including the 2004–2006 website warning despite some API records. Use ukparl_lookup_reference topic=coverage for archive guidance. Follow collection cursors unchanged and contentCursor for lossless oversized contributions; retry timeouts with shorter date windows.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `http_invalid_params`: The official API returned HTTP 400 for this request. `http_unauthorized`: The official public API returned HTTP 401. `http_forbidden`: The official public API returned HTTP 402 or 403. `http_conflict`: The official API returned HTTP 409, 423 or 424. `http_rate_limited`: The official API returned HTTP 429 after bounded retry handling. `http_invalid_request`: The official API returned an unexpected redirect or another unsupported HTTP client response. `invalid_cursor`: Collection or content cursor is invalid or bound to another selection. `source_changed`: Selected contribution data changed during content reconstruction. `invalid_date_range`: Date bounds are impossible or reversed. `queue_full`: Hansard origin request queue is full. `attempt_timeout`: A Spoken source attempt timed out. `call_deadline_exceeded`: The shared call deadline elapsed while searching Spoken contributions. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
